"After putting pen to paper to take the reins of <TeamName1>, <ManagerName1> was asked by local media whether he will be interested in managing a national team in addition to his club duties. ""That would be a huge honour. Every manager dreams of shining on the international stage and winning trophies with a national team"", said the manager, adding that ""...it would be very special for me if one day I can manage my home nation and bring joy to my country, but for now I need to focus on the next task, and that is to have a successful campaign with <TeamName1>""\n\nDespite <ManagerName1>'s lack of experience, it is not hard to imagine that some national teams will have him on their radar now that he has entered the scene. If he can get off to a good start and string together some wins, there will be no shortage of interest from different football associations looking to hire a coach for the top job."

"<FullPlayerName> has remained quiet amid the rumours that he may soon depart <TeamName> after refusing to resign with the team, but last night his agent commented on the situation. Speaking from his office he said, ""I am able to talk about the rumours that are surrounding <FullPlayerName>, but please understand that this is a fluid situation and no decisions have been taken. <PlayerName> is very happy at <TeamName>, he has no problem with the club, it's wonderful supporters or the other players. What we are considering though is what the next step should be for him. There are leagues he has not played in, which interest him. He's a free spirit and he wants to experience the world of football, he's not one of these players that can be content to stay at the same club for their entire careers. So until he makes up his mind about where he sees his future, he's not going to be resigning with <TeamName>."""

The Global Transfer Network is a new way of playing your Career as a manager. Now you can send your staff of scouts to different countries around the world in search for talent.

Specify the type of player you are looking for by giving a range of criteria to your scouting network based on your team's needs. Your scouts will look in their different regions for players that match any of your criteria. Better scouts cost more money to sign, but they are faster at providing research and their information is more accurate. Another way to use your network is to ask one of your scouts to look at a player that you already have in mind, but need more information on.

Now you're ready to start your career as a manager. Managing your scouting network and finding new talent will be crucial to your success at the club. Make sure you are directing them throughout the year so you are prepared for the frantic transfer window.

Welcome to the world's biggest interactive virtual league.  Every time you earn XP playing FIFA 17 you contribute those points to your club.  A club's success in their league is based on the amount of XP their supporters generate for them on a daily basis.  
Clubs are placed in their appropriate leagues throughout the world, and the clubs with the most passionate FIFA fans will win their tables and earn promotion.  Teams with little support will finish near the bottom and face relegation.  Promotions and relegations will follow real world rules.  
Each season lasts a week.  The tables will constantly be changing each day and you'll need to make sure you contribute as much XP as you can to support your club and keep them from being relegated.
Contributing Points
The XP you earn is automatically contributed to the club you are supporting.  While you are contributing points to your club, so too are the millions of other FIFA 17 players across the globe.

Hello %1s,

My name is %2s and I am one of your scouts. I just wanted to say hello and inform you how the other scouts and I can help you.

We have two types of scouting:

By Region: you will send scouts out to a specific region of the world and we will report back the players we find that match your Scouting Instructions.

Player Specific: you can assign a scout to watch specific players. You can do this when the scouts have found players through Region Scouting, or if you already have some names in mind, you can search for them and assign a scout to them.

A scout who is assigned to a Region can only look at players specifically if they play in that region. If for example I was scouting in Spain, I can only give you more details on players in Spain.

You might want to avoid assigning one of our Scouts to Region Scouting so that he can do the player focused scouting outside of any region already being scouted, but the choice is yours.

That's all for now.
%2s

Welcome to Online Leagues.

Here you can join or create create your own leagues of up to 32 members.

The My Leagues screen allows you to see what leagues you are currently a member of. You can also search for leagues to join. You will need to meet the requirements of the leagues Reputation (REP) level and its Did Not Finish Percentage (DNF%) level in order to join most leagues. Some leagues are private leagues and you will need to contact a League GM to obtain the password.  

At the beginning of the season, League GMs set the number of games each member of the league needs to play against every other member. Once all possible combinations of games have been played, the season is considered over and that members name is marked beside the League Trophy.

League members can leave a league at any time and their contributions to the league are erased.

To challenge another league member to a league game, select their name from the League Standings screen.

Co-op Seasons is the next evolution in online play, allowing you and a Friend to team up online and play 2v2; to take the challenge of reaching Division 1 and filling up your trophy cabinet. Each Friend you choose creates a separate season, allowing you to play with multiple Friends at your own pace.

When you're ready to play, enter the Co-op Seasons Lobby where you'll become the ‘captain' and can set your preferred club, starting lineup, and match settings.  Wait for your Friend to join you in the Lobby, or send them an Alert to meet you there. Co-op Seasons Alerts can be seen as notifications in the game, and can be accepted from inside EA SPORTS Football Club or the News & Alerts tile.  In addition, any Friends waiting in the Lobby will have an indicator so you can easily see who's ready to play. Once you are both in the Lobby, the captain can make changes and search for opponents to play. 

Tell your Friends, organise your play times, and see if you can get to Division 1 in Co-op Seasons this year in FIFA 17.

In Ultimate Team there are two types of tournaments available to play: Online, and Single Player. Each of the tournament types will feature rotating featured tournaments. These featured tournaments will be available for a limited time, they'll have the most interesting entry requirements and highest rewards. Once a featured tournament closes it will not come around again, so you must win it while it's open to claim the trophy!

Online tournaments will test your skill against other players Ultimate Team's. Single Player tournaments will have you face clubs under AI Control.

Each Single Player tournament has a minimum difficulty level that determines the difficutly for the teams under AI control. If you would like a bigger challenge you can increase the difficulty level for a chance at greater end of match rewards.

Every tournament has a bonus that is awarded to the team of the tournament. The team of the tournament is awarded to the team that performs the best in the finals. The Team of the Tournament is not necessarily the team that wins – it's the most impressive team in the final.

Scoring
Each day the clubs are ranked in order of their supporter's ‘Average XP Contribution'.  We add up the total amount of XP each club receives from their supporters and divide that by the number of supporters in the club to get the Average XP Contribution per member.  So, if a club receives 1,500,000 XP on Monday and has 1000 supporters they will have an average of 1500 XP.  
At the end of each day teams will be given points based on how they ranked that day.  The points are based on the number of clubs in each league.  So, the last place team gets 1 point, the second to last gets 2 points, third gets 3 points, and so on.  Those points are added up each day and the club that ends up with the most points at the end of the week wins the season.
Selecting Your Club
When you first booted up FIFA 17 you selected your favourite club.  That club is who you are supporting in the all new and exciting Support Your Club feature.  
If you would like to change your club you can do so in the EAS FC Support Your Club panel. The change won't take place until the next Support Your Club season begins on Monday, so you will continue to support your old club until the change takes effect.
You will only be able to change the club you support a limited amount of times.  So, choose carefully.
